shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot inside a small neighbourhood library in soft daylight. Lena, a young woman with light brown curly hair tied back, an olive-green cardigan and small round glasses, stands at the wooden desk, one hand on the counter; the librarian, a woman in her fifties with short silver hair and a brown cardigan with a blank round pin, looks up from behind the desk. Tall shelves with completely blank book spines behind them; a green reading lamp on the desk. Vertical composition.

shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Medium shot across the desk: Lena asks, leaning in slightly, eyebrows raised in a hopeful question; the librarian listens with a patient smile. Soft window light, blurred blank book spines behind. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k3
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Close-up of the librarian's hands lifting a plain, titleless hardcover book from a low shelf and turning it so the blank cover faces Lena; another blank book lies open on the desk. Shallow depth of field, warm light. Vertical composition.

shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting.
